\]

- \( n = 8 \)

Rearranging the formula to solve for \( r_0 \):

\[
r_0 = \frac{e^2}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 \left(1 - \frac{1}{n}\right) |E_{\text{equ}}|}
\]

Substituting the values:
\[
r_0 = \frac{(1.6 \times 10^{-19})^2}{4 \pi (8.85 \times 10^{-12}) \left(1 - \frac{1}{8}\right) (6.144 \times 10^{-19})}
\]

2. \( 4 \pi \varepsilon_0 = 4 \times 3.1416 \times 8.85 \times 10^{-12} = 1.112 \times 10^{-10} \, \text{F/m} \)

\[

\]

\[
P^{-3 / 5} d P=-g\left(\frac{1}{K}\right)^{3 / 5} d z
\]

\[
\frac{5}{2}\left(P^{2 / 5}-P_{0}^{2 / 5}\right)=-g K^{-3 / 5} z
\]

\[
